payload.report: Antimicrobial failure favored neoplasia. Biopsy showed clonal CD20+/CD79a+/CD5+ B cells; PET-CT showed FDG-avid abdominal/peripancreatic nodes; morphology supported secondary involvement. This confirms systemic B-cell lymphoma with secondary penile ulceration. CD5+ favors MCL, but cyclin D1, t(11;14)/CCND1 FISH, and SOX11 are unavailable, so MCL is likely.
